verdict.rationale: Sai is itself a computer-use agent, but first-party platform docs name an official MCP server package, `@simular-ai/sai-mcp`, which coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) use to drive it. That makes the server axis applicable, and the core of the story is delivered. Supporting docs show the underlying task API that the agent-facing integration exposes. Missing for 10: detailed MCP setup/configuration docs, a list of exposed tools, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP server works as described.
